title: AEC Hackathon answer key (manifest.json)
description: Ground truth for one dataset. Lives next to the documents as manifest.json. It never enters the sandbox. A reported error matches a manifest entry when document and category match AND (the report's location/description contains the page number, or contains one of the keywords, or the report echoes the entry id). Matching is one-to-one.

id.description: Optional unique id, e.g. T01. Auto-assigned when omitted.

location.description: Optional. Where the error appears. When keywords are omitted, matching anchors are derived from the digit-bearing tokens in location + description (tags like CG-1, rooms like S102, values like 35).

document.description: File name (as listed in files.json) that contains the INCORRECT information. Compared case-insensitively, extension ignored.

category.description: Error category. Must match the reported category (normalized: lowercase, non-alphanumerics collapse to dashes).

page.description: Optional. Matches when any integer in the report's location or description equals this page number.

keywords.description: Optional but strongly recommended. Matches when any keyword appears (case-insensitive substring) in the report's location or description. Give 2-4 distinctive strings a correct finding would almost surely mention (equipment marks, wrong values, section numbers).

description.description: Human explanation of the injected error: the wrong value, the right value, and where each lives. Not used for matching.
